name: Twitter / X
summary: Protect your posts, disable behavioral ad tracking, and switch to app-based 2FA.

settings.name: Protect Your Posts
settings.impact: Public tweets are indexed by search engines and accessible to data brokers indefinitely. Protecting posts means only approved followers can see them.
settings.source: Comparitech: 'Twitter Privacy Settings Guide'; MyPrivacy.Blog X Security Guide 2025

settings.name: Ad & Data Personalization
settings.impact: X uses behavioral data including off-platform activity to target ads and build user profiles. Disabling all personalization settings cuts off this profiling at the source.

settings.name: Discoverability via Email / Phone
clickPath: Uncheck 'Let people find you by email' and 'Let people find you by phone number'
settings.impact: Data brokers buy contact lists and use X's discoverability feature to map email addresses and phone numbers to X profiles, enriching their databases.

settings.name: Location in Posts
settings.impact: Attaching location to tweets creates a permanent, searchable record of your physical movements. This data has been used in stalking cases.

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: X removed free SMS 2FA for non-Premium users in 2023. Use an authenticator app — it is significantly more resistant to SIM-swap attacks than SMS.
